== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-matt-lutz-ls-the-hyperdrive-generators-gone-v/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Lutz LS Hyperdrive(v).txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114035842/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-matt-lutz-ls-the-hyperdrive-generators-gone-v.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>5427c9a32bfd6f7f6cd32a5255b331f629f7995599f787c23f5387c37c082dab</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 22 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Captain Rex, 501st Legion (ALT) (Errata 3)]]: XML <nowiki>200_3^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 1x [[Plo Koon (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>210_23^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
